title: Belief
description: A belief. Class-level properties describe the belief type/category. Instance-level properties describe a concrete agent-held belief at a specific time, including confidence and supporting evidence.

id.description: [instance-level] Stable identifier for this belief record.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this belief belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent holding this belief.

fact_id.description: [class-level] Identifier of the ground-truth fact this belief concerns.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when this belief state was recorded.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the belief record format.

content.description: [instance-level] The agent's natural-language statement of what it believes.

confidence.description: [instance-level] Agent's confidence in this belief (0 to 1).

is_correct.description: [instance-level] Whether the belief matches ground truth (authoritative, inaccessible to the agent).

evidence_ids.description: [instance-level] Identifiers of evidence records supporting this belief.

examples.content: The coconut moves when I touch it.
